raw_order_events.description: Order lifecycle events as newline-delimited JSON under raw/order-events/. One JSON object per line. Not partitioned: a future Firehose layout uses year/month/day prefixes, and those prefixes are not registered yet.

columns.name: schema_version
columns.comment: Contract version. The JSON Schema requires 1.

columns.name: event_id
columns.comment: Unique id of this lifecycle event.

columns.name: event_type
columns.comment: OrderPlaced, OrderPaid, OrderShipped, or OrderCancelled.

columns.name: occurred_at
columns.comment: When the event happened, ISO-8601 UTC text, matching the JSON Schema. Not a timestamp column.

columns.name: order_id
columns.comment: Order id, shared by every event for that order.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: Customer id on this event.

columns.name: currency
columns.comment: Three-letter currency code.

columns.name: total_amount
columns.comment: Money as a decimal string with two fraction digits, for example 24.00. Not a JSON number and not a float.

columns.name: items
columns.comment: Lines on this event. quantity is units on the line. unit_price is a decimal string. item_count on gold is the length of this array, not the sum of quantity.

raw_product_catalog.description: Product catalog file drop as newline-delimited JSON under raw/product-catalog/. This is the lake file, not the DynamoDB table. Not partitioned.

columns.name: schema_version
columns.comment: Contract version. The JSON Schema requires 1.

columns.name: product_id
columns.comment: Product id. Same id the DynamoDB catalog uses when that table exists.

columns.name: sku
columns.comment: Stock keeping unit.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Display name.

columns.name: category
columns.comment: Category. The DynamoDB GSI uses the same attribute.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: active or discontinued.

columns.name: price
columns.comment: Money as a decimal string with two fraction digits. Not a JSON number.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: When this catalog item was updated, ISO-8601 UTC text.

raw_reviews.description: Review file drop as newline-delimited JSON under raw/reviews/. summary is not part of this file. Not partitioned.

columns.name: schema_version
columns.comment: Contract version. The JSON Schema requires 1.

columns.name: review_id
columns.comment: Review id.

columns.name: product_id
columns.comment: Product the review is about.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: Customer who wrote the review.

columns.name: rating
columns.comment: Whole number from 1 to 5.

columns.name: body
columns.comment: Review text.

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: When the review was created, ISO-8601 UTC text.

gold_orders.description: One row per order, newline-delimited JSON under gold/orders/order_date=YYYY-MM-DD/. item_count is the number of lines on the winning event, not the sum of quantities and not the number of events. status is placed, paid, shipped, or cancelled. Partition order_date is the UTC date of placed_at.

partition_keys.name: order_date
partition_keys.comment: UTC calendar date of placed_at, yyyy-MM-dd. Read from the directory order_date=YYYY-MM-DD, not from the JSON line.

columns.name: order_id
columns.comment: Order id. One gold row per order.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: Customer on the latest event for this order.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: placed, paid, shipped, or cancelled. Latest event wins.

columns.name: currency
columns.comment: Three-letter currency code from the latest event.

columns.name: total_amount
columns.comment: Decimal string with two fraction digits. Logical type is DECIMAL(12, 2); cast in the query. The file does not use a JSON number.

columns.name: placed_at
columns.comment: Earliest OrderPlaced time, UTC. Later events do not move it. Parsed from ISO-8601 text by timestamp.formats.

columns.name: item_count
columns.comment: Number of lines on the winning event. A line with quantity 2 still counts as 1. Two events for one order do not add their line counts.

gold_reviews.description: Review mart as newline-delimited JSON under gold/reviews/created_date=YYYY-MM-DD/. created_date is the UTC date of created_at. summary stays empty until a later write. No review transform is registered in this apply.

partition_keys.name: created_date
partition_keys.comment: UTC calendar date of created_at, yyyy-MM-dd. Directory name created_date=YYYY-MM-DD.

columns.name: review_id
columns.comment: Review id.

columns.name: product_id
columns.comment: Product the review is about.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: Customer who wrote the review.

columns.name: rating
columns.comment: Whole number from 1 to 5.

columns.name: body
columns.comment: Review text.

columns.name: created_at
columns.comment: When the review was created, UTC. Parsed from ISO-8601 text by timestamp.formats.

columns.name: summary
columns.comment: Short model summary. Not in the raw review file. Null until a later write.
